caption: The drawing depicts a decorative plaque or monument, standing at an angle, featuring a combination of geometric and ornamental elements. The main structure is a rectangular panel bordered with green edges, and it displays a large area of text rendered in black lines and symbols. Above the text, there is a smaller rectangular section containing an illustration of two figures; one standing, another seated under a tree, all colored in muted greens, browns, and red tones. The plaque is topped with a triangular pediment bordered in green. Down the left side of the plaque, there are vertical, ribbon-like decorative elements colored in red, white, and green, with a floral motif near the bottom and some circular ornamental accents. An intricately shaped corbel or bracket supports a large, projecting shelf beneath the main plaque, featuring scroll-like designs in shades of beige, cream, and hints of red. The entire structure is set against a plain, light beige background, and a small number "19" appears at the bottom left corner.
title: Plate 19: Reading Stand: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
